title: Polimill builds Japan's next-generation public AI infrastructure
summary: Polimill uses OpenAI GPT models and Codex to help municipalities search and use administrative knowledge while accelerating development.
body: Polimill uses OpenAI GPT models and Codex to help municipalities search and use administrative knowledge while accelerating development.
summaryZh: 日本Polimill公司正在利用OpenAI的GPT模型和Codex技术，构建下一代公共AI基础设施。该项目旨在帮助地方政府更高效地检索和利用行政知识，从而加速公共服务的数字化转型与开发进程。
